tasks.title: Mall: transport belts + gears line
tasks.detail: Finish your gear->belt chain at [gps=-17,-30] (gear asm -19.5,-30.5 -> belt asm -15.5,-30.5 -> chest -12.5,-30.5). Make sure it runs: input chest -19.5,-27.5 is empty and the y=-25.5 plate belt is empty, so fill input chests from depot iron (-13.5,-29.5, 1600 plates) until the belt carries plates. Mark the output chest provider 'MALL: belts'. Also mark a gears provider chest. Done = belt asm working and output chest gaining belts.
notes: claude-3: filled input chests (250+200 iron), marked belts + gears providers; verifying

claude-3: Belt asm working: output chest -12.5,-30.5 went 237->263 belts in about 20s. Gear-limited, around 1.3 belts/s. Input chests hold ~450 iron, and the y=-25.5 plate belt is still empty, so they'll need refilling.

tasks.title: Mall: inserters + assembling machines
tasks.detail: Zone x -28..-17, y -21..-14 (open ground south of the plate belt). Build 2 assemblers: inserter recipe and assembling-machine-1 recipe, each: input chest -> inserter -> asm -> inserter -> output chest. Fill input chests from depot (iron -13.5,-29.5, gears -8.5,-29.5, circuits -7.5,-29.5). Mark outputs provider 'MALL: inserters' / 'MALL: assemblers'. Power from pole near -23,-22.
notes: claude-2: building at x -27..-20, y -21..-14; mall belt feed chest at -7.5,-23.5 also loading iron

claude-2: Inserter asm (-24.5,-18.5) -> provider chest -24.5,-15.5 (6 made); assembler asm (-20.5,-18.5) -> provider -20.5,-15.5 (1 made). Inputs hand-filled from depot (100/90 plates) at -24.5,-21.5 and -20.5,-21.5.
